messages:
Sara M (People Ops): quick q — can managers initiate an off-cycle band reclassification and request retroactive pay? what docs/approvals do we need?
Alex R (Eng Manager): yes — one of my ICs was missed in calibration. manager asks effective 2026-02-01 and wants backpay. what's the workflow?
Nina K (HRBP): short answer: allowed but gated. we need manager justification + calibration notes + evidence of impact/role change. also comp committee approval for anything that changes band or base beyond normal ranges. retro dates limited — prefer within same quarter.
Mike L (Comp Ops): process we follow: 1) manager files band-change request form (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/band-change) 2) attach manager rationale + work samples + prior calibration notes 3) HRBP verifies org fit 4) Comp Ops + Comp Committee sign off 5) send final approval to Payroll. After that payroll ingests for backpay run.
Jordan P (Payroll): deadlines to keep in mind: approvals must be to payroll by the 10th of the month to affect the next pay run. backpay is a separate payroll transaction and typically posts within 1-2 cycles after approvals are received. if approval misses cutoff we'll schedule next run, which delays payment.
Alex R (Eng Manager): got it. what's the expected timeline from submission to comp committee sign-off?
Mike L (Comp Ops): depends on queue but expect 5-10 business days for comp review if packet is complete. incomplete packets cause delays — please include explicit calibration notes and any 1:1 feedback examples.
Sara M (People Ops): note: if title change affects benefit eligibility (e.g., moves to manager band), we also need HRIS update and manager to submit org chart change so benefits team can reconcile.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder — use the /band-request form in People Ops Jira to start the flow. Template: https://confluence.redwood.com/templates/band-request (fill sections A-D).
Nina K (HRBP): equity grants/repricing are separate — cc rewards@redwood.com when you submit. rewards will need a separate approval and grant paperwork; timing can differ from base backpay.
Alex R (Eng Manager): perfect. i'll gather evidence and submit today. tnx! :thumbsup:
Mike L (Comp Ops): i'll DM you the checklist and confirm payroll cutoffs for Feb retro so you know if it's feasible this cycle.
Jordan P (Payroll): FYI — if backpay spans multiple pay periods we itemize on the stub with code BCR. keep comp ops looped so we can code correctly.
Sara M (People Ops): thanks everyone — filing this thread into the band-change tracker. Alex, ping here if you hit any blockers after submission.
